job.description:
Social Media Platform Launch & Ongoing Management
Job Title: Social Media Manager — Full Launch & Ongoing Management for Wellness/Hydration Brand (H2Drate)
Job Category: Social Media Marketing
Project Type: Ongoing, long-term 
Overview
H2Drate is looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to own our social presence from the ground up — from initial platform setup through ongoing daily management. You'll be fully responsible for strategy, content, posting, community engagement, ad spend recommendations, and performance reporting. This is a hands-on, ownership role, not a "post and forget" gig — we want someone who treats our channels like their own brand.
Scope of Work
Phase 1 — Platform Launch & Setup
•	Audit and set up/optimize brand profiles across relevant platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and/or others as agreed)
•	Develop brand voice, visual style guide, and content pillars in line with H2Drate's identity
•	Build out initial content calendar and posting cadence
•	Set up analytics/tracking (native platform insights plus any third-party tools)
•	Recommend an initial advertising budget and channel mix for paid social (to be approved by H2Drate before spend begins)
Phase 2 — Ongoing Management
•	Full content creation: graphics, short-form video, copywriting, and any other assets needed (own or coordinate with a designer/videographer if applicable)
•	Own and maintain the content calendar end-to-end
•	Daily posting, community management, and timely response to comments/DMs
•	Plan, launch, and manage paid social advertising campaigns within the approved budget
•	Continuously test and optimize content and ad performance (A/B testing, audience targeting, creative iteration)
•	Track KPIs: follower growth, engagement rate, reach/impressions, click-through rate, conversion/ROAS on paid spend, and any other metrics we agree on
Reporting & Meetings
•	Weekly check-in call to review performance reporting, metrics, and upcoming content
•	Monthly brand planning & strategy meeting to align on goals, campaigns, and budget for the following month
•	Written performance report provided ahead of each weekly check-in
Requirements
•	Proven experience launching and managing social media accounts for a brand (consumer products/wellness/CPG experience a plus)
•	Strong content creation skills (graphic design and/or short-form video editing)
•	Experience running and optimizing paid social ad campaigns with a defined budget
•	Comfortable owning strategy and reporting independently — this is not a role where we hand you a content calendar to execute
•	Excellent written communication in English
•	Available for a recurring weekly call and a monthly strategy meeting
To Apply
Please include:
1.	Links to social accounts you've managed (before/after growth if available)
2.	Examples of content you personally created (not just curated)
3.	A brief note on how you'd approach the first 30 days of a brand-new account launch
4.	Your recommended starting monthly ad budget range for a new consumer wellness brand and why
